summary: Validator covers pure-table/decoder helpers (CSR, SBI, syscall, ABI, prologue, brev8, mcause, qemu MMIO, fp_rm, fclass, c_classify). The only MCP-exposed surface is `analysis_disasm_at_path_riscv` which requires a loader-supported binary (ELF/PE). There is no MCP wrapper for any of the validator's pure functions, and no validator coverage of full-binary disasm. Overlap of testable inputs between the two surfaces is therefore empty.

mcp_tools_inspected.name: analysis_disasm_at_path_riscv
mcp_tools_inspected.behavior: Loads binary via registered loaders; raw .bin returns 'no registered loader can handle format: Unknown'. Requires ELF/PE.

mcp_outputs.test: disasm raw .bin (3 RV64I words: addi sp,sp,-32; sd ra,24(sp); sd s0,16(sp))

result.text: execution failed: internal error: load failed: loader: no registered loader can handle format: Unknown

gap_findings: MCP exposes no tool for CSR/SBI/syscall/ABI/QEMU-MMIO/prologue/brev8 lookups despite these being deterministic, well-specified RISC-V helpers worth surfacing.

analysis_disasm_at_path_riscv cannot be exercised against raw byte buffers; there is no `analysis_disasm_bytes_riscv` or analogous in-memory disasm tool. Validator's decode_compressed/decode_rvv/decode_stream cannot be tested through MCP without crafting a fake ELF.
